Hello! This is an update by ParaSpider in regards to your newest submission for the contest, Canes Venatici. Your map has been accepted for the Avicus Network, and will be loaded into the repository. As well as this, this post has been recognized and submitted to the spreadsheet for any further review. 

As for your position in the contest, it has not yet been announced but thank you for your contribution.
